ChatPage.click_create_new_conversation uses testid sidebar-create-button, but DEV now serves sidebar-new-chat-button (text 'New chat'). The old handle timed out in my probe. The implementer should verify this and either fix the page object or use the new testid.

Case step 3 says the new chat appears 'with its generated name'. The generated title is nondeterministic (observed 'Word SMK4.', and transiently '#autotest_runner_…The word SMK4.'). The AFS asserts the row and spinner only, not the title.
The 4953 spec defines the long_runner_agent fixture inside its test file, which violates the fixture-location rule. For reuse it should be moved to automation/fixtures/ and registered in conftest.
If the #agent is not actually selected before Send, the run is a plain LLM reply with no tools (seen in an early probe). The AFS requires asserting the participant is set before sending.

The UI-created chat's list-row testid carries a client-side uuid (not an int) until the run ends. The spec locates the new chat by its running row, re-resolves the id after the run, and the cleanup fixture uses a list_conversations diff. Worth adding to _surface.md as an observation; I did not edit it.
